name: Peleth
overview: Peleth is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Jonathan. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional personal details or notable events recorded beyond his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Peleth is a proper name that may mean 'swift' or 'swiftness,' suggesting a characteristic possibly attributed to him or his family line. This meaning, however, is not explicitly connected to any narrative in Scripture and serves primarily as an etymological note.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Peleth as the son of Jonathan. No further family relationships are documented, and no additional relational context is provided beyond this filial connection.
scriptureSignificance: Peleth's significance lies chiefly in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah, highlighting the continuation of the family line through Jonathan. While not a prominent biblical character, his mention contributes to the detailed genealogies that affirm God's providential preservation of His chosen people.
